description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding on Sports and Youth Development between the Maldives and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Maldives and Sri Lanka have agreed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding on Sports and Youth Development between the two countries with the aim of enhancing long-term cooperation in the fields of youth development and sports development, establishing a structured framework for the same, exchange of programmes, expertise, technical knowledge and capacity building initiatives thereby empowering the youth of the two countries, developing leadership, improving sports performance and institutional cooperation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Republic of Maldives and the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.
